_comment: EXAMPLE GCP env->coordinates map for the KGA cloud tiers (5/6/7). Mount this file and point KGA_GCP_ENV_MATRIX_FILE at it (or inline the same JSON in KGA_GCP_ENV_MATRIX). Per env: project+region required; cluster+namespace needed for k8s discovery/log filters. No values are compiled into source — configuring this is what enables the tiers.
